corrections.why: The firetower.org register page for US 1768 gives Clatsop County coordinates (N 45.859174, W 123.856190), and the firelookout.org Clatsop entry sits at 45.85933, -123.85696. The Curry County point appears to belong to a different Sugarloaf Mountain that the firelookout.org list also tags US 1768. Editor to confirm before applying.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firetower.org ties US 1768 to Clatsop County (871 m, ODF Clatsop FPA). firelookout.org's county list ties it to a Curry County Sugarloaf Mountain at 42.838, -124.235. The story follows the register page for this record and says the conflict is open; it does not resolve which site holds the number.

sources.title: Sugarloaf Mountain Lookout Site (Clatsop County)
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: The record's county (Clatsop) and elevation (871 m) match the firetower.org Clatsop page, but its coordinates (42.83802, -124.23487) are the Curry County point that firelookout.org attaches to US 1768. A proposed coordinate correction is in corrections; confirm against the register before applying. firelookout.com's Clatsop detail page says '9 miles NNE of Newhalem', which would place it in Washington State; treated as an error and not used. SummitPost is a climbing trip report with directions to private land; the story uses only its ownership statement and does not repeat the route. Sources read: firetower.org Clatsop page, firelookout.com Clatsop and Curry pages, firelookout.org county list, Oregon Lookouts Sugarloaf page (twice), SummitPost; one web search. No abandonment event is recorded because the sources give only the 1930s.
